summary_en: Correction to Nice Corporation's public tender offer for Yamadai Co., Ltd. (7426), filed 2 June 2026. Units in financial statements amended from thousand yen to million yen in Yamadai's FY3/26 earnings: revenue 4,102 million yen, operating loss 286 million yen, net loss attributable to parent 280 million yen.
title_en: Correction Notice: Partial Revision to the Announcement of Commencement of Public Tender Offer for Yamadai Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 7426)
translation_en_brief: This is a correction notice to Nice Corporation's public tender offer for Yamadai Co., Ltd., disclosed on 1 June 2026. The correction addresses an error in the financial statements of the target company (Yamadai). The units in Yamadai's FY3/26 consolidated earnings summary were incorrectly stated in thousand yen and have been revised to million yen. The corrected figures show: revenue of 4,102 million yen, operating loss of 286 million yen, ordinary loss of 263 million yen, and net loss attributable to parent shareholders of 280 million yen. No changes to the tender offer terms, timing, or other material aspects of the transaction are indicated in this correction notice.
